turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Instead of the nightly tarp, move the firewood pile more than 30 feet from the house or cover it with sheet metal.
findings.reason: The homeowner said the firewood sits right against the wall and is only covered with a tarp at night.

findings.instruction: Replace the old cedar fence part within 5 feet of the house with metal, brick or another material that will not burn.
findings.reason: The homeowner said the fence is old cedar that was there when they bought the place.

findings.instruction: Even though the cut brush is still green, bag it for yard waste pickup to clear within 30 feet of the house.
findings.reason: The homeowner said the brush was cut last weekend and has not been hauled away yet.
